name: Reese's Peanut Butter Cups (Smooth Micro-Milled Peanut Center)
whyItWorks: Unlike candy bars with whole peanuts (Snickers, PayDay), Reese's uses a smooth, micro-ground peanut paste mixed with powdered sugar. There are zero sharp nut fragments to scratch the intestinal lining.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat 1 cup slowly. Safe in remission when craving peanut butter and chocolate.
watchOuts: Contains peanut fat and milk; limit portion if currently experiencing active bile malabsorption.
